title: Toys and Belongings
introduction: Practise toys and belongings with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: We can name toys and say who owns them.
rules: Point to toys and describe them.
Use my for something that belongs to you.

grammar.description: A kite that belongs to me.
A ball that belongs to the person I am speaking to.

vocabulary.description: A toy flown in the wind.
A toy shaped like a person.
A vehicle that travels on rails.

examples.question: A toy that flies on a string is a ___.
steps: Point to toys and describe them.

examples.question: A soft toy bear is a teddy ___.
steps: Use my for something that belongs to you.

exercises.question: A toy that flies on a string is a ___.
A soft toy bear is a teddy ___.
This is ___ toy. It belongs to me.
This is ___ bag. It belongs to you.

summary: We can name toys and say who owns them.
